title: Pure Mayakashi
summary: The pure Mayakashi Zombie Synchro and Link ladder build with generic staples. A single starter climbs from Level 3 Oboro-Guruma all the way up to Level 11 Gashadokuro and the Yuki-Onna Links, then steps back down the ladder from the GY each time a Synchro or Link is destroyed.

summary.title: Starters
points: Hajun, the Winged Mayakashi Special Summons any Mayakashi monster from the Deck (specifically Dakki, the Graceful Mayakashi) when Normal or Special Summoned.
Mayakashi Return searches any Mayakashi card or sends it to the GY.

Shafu, the Wheeled Mayakashi revives a Level 4 or lower Mayakashi in Defense Position, while Yuki-Musume, the Ice Mayakashi Special Summons itself from the hand or GY and dumps a Zombie from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: 1-Card Hajun into the Full Synchro & Link Ladder
steps: Normal Summon Hajun, the Winged Mayakashi to Special Summon Dakki, the Graceful Mayakashi from the Deck.
Synchro Summon Level 3 Oboro-Guruma, the Wheeled Mayakashi; Dakki revives itself from the GY whenever a Mayakashi is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck.
Repeat the Synchro climb with Dakki through Level 5 Tsuchigumo, Level 7 Tengu, Level 9 Yoko, and Level 11 Gashadokuro, the Skeletal Mayakashi.
Revive Dakki one more time and use Yuki-Musume, the Ice Mayakashi to Link Summon Yuki-Onna, the Ice Mayakashi, Yuki-Onna, the Icicle Mayakashi, or Yuki-Onna, the Absolute Zero Mayakashi.

summary.title: Reverse-Ladder Recursion
summary.text: Every Mayakashi Synchro sits in the GY after the initial climb and banishes another Zombie from the GY to revive itself whenever a Mayakashi one step above it is destroyed: Level 11 Gashadokuro revives when a Link Monster is destroyed (becoming unaffected by other cards' effects for the turn), Level 9 Yoko revives when a Level 11 is destroyed (destroying an opponent's monster without targeting), Level 7 Tengu destroys a Spell/Trap, Level 5 Tsuchigumo mills 3 from both Decks, and Level 3 Oboro-Guruma grants battle destruction immunity.

summary.title: Control & Locks
points: Yuki-Onna, the Icicle Mayakashi negates a monster's effects on summon and banishes itself from the GY as a Quick Effect to summon a banished or GY Zombie Synchro (triggering its revival effect!).
Yuki-Onna, the Absolute Zero Mayakashi permanently drops an opponent's monster's ATK to 0 and negates its effects whenever a monster is Special Summoned from the GY or while banished.

Ghost Meets Girl - A Masterful Mayakashi Shiranui Saga Tributes a Mayakashi Synchro or Link Monster to lock both players out of Special Summoning from the hand, Deck, and Extra Deck for the rest of the turn.
Hajun, Shafu, Dakki, and Yuki-Musume lock your Extra Deck summons to Mayakashi monsters while they are on the field or for the turn.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Mayakashi Mayhem triggers whenever a Zombie Synchro is Special Summoned from anywhere other than the Extra Deck to draw 1 card, Set a Mayakashi Spell/Trap from the Deck, or send the opponent's lowest-ATK monster to the GY.
Ghost Meets Girl - A Mayakashi's Manuscript revives a Zombie with the same Attribute as a Zombie Synchro you control during either Main Phase.
Mayakashi Winter reduces opposing monsters' ATK/DEF by 100 per differently named Mayakashi in your GY, and Mayakashi Metamorphosis revives a Mayakashi from the GY or banishment.
